headline: Gameweek 11 is coming, and this channel's creators are pushing transfer ideas, so keep your 15-minute decision simple and check team news first.

points.text: One creator says João Pedro is out for Gameweek 11. Check the official team news before you make any changes.
points.label: reported

points.text: Several videos from the same channel cover Gameweek 11 team selection, transfer tips and early plans.
points.label: reported

points.text: One creator asks whether selling Haaland soon is crazy. This is an open question, not advice to sell.
points.label: opinion

points.text: One creator covers whether to keep or sell Man United attackers, and whether to use a Free Hit chip and when.
points.label: opinion

points.text: Many of these videos are paid ads for a FPL guide site. Treat their tips as one view, not a sure thing.
points.label: ai interpretation

differences.text: The channel's own videos mention both Gameweek 10 and Gameweek 11 in their previews, so check which week a video is about before you act on it.
